purpose: C0 run contract: the exact commands, environments, ownership and allowed paths the uninterrupted window executes.

applicationSuite.why: It is the only path that carries the guarded authority: marker acquisition, database lease, owned-cluster teardown, per-child deadline and abandonment handling, and the verdict/exit-code contract. Direct Vitest execution bypasses all of it.
applicationSuite.note: Each line is a separate gated command. Stop on nonzero status; do not continue through failure.

nativeUnit.note: test:node is an explicit file list; new native files are NOT auto-discovered and must be wired exactly once in backend/package.json row 19.

browser.note: The launcher rejects an absent or unowned BASE_URL rather than selecting a fallback server.

typecheck.retainedCaveat: The heap setting declares an intent, not available memory. Record actual completion or the exact blocker.

run-owned-postgres-matrix.why: It is the historical matrix runner. Its recorded 10-suite/125-test result does not execute the new application suites, and it does not carry the marker/lease/verdict contract that C1 makes load-bearing.

config/config.cjs.why: Line 1 is require('dotenv').config({ path: '../.env' }). A harness resolved through it inherits the application environment, so it cannot establish an independent test identity and its --env development invocation pointed at the application database.
config/config.cjs.boundary: This is a retirement for test/migration execution only. The application's own runtime config is untouched.

vitest.coach-completion.config.mjs.why: 04-build-order row 7 proposed a separate completion config. Row 14 of the forged order keeps the existing backend/vitest.coach-postgres.config.mjs and states 'no alternate completion config'. The existing guarded config is the single config (R5-06).
